faq: Does it replace my current search?
It can, or it can sit beside it. Many clients start by adding it as the main box and keeping the old search as a fallback for a week. We agree which approach suits you before we build.
Will it work with Shopify or WordPress?
Yes. We connect to your product or content data through the platform's own tools, and we add the search box to your theme. For custom sites we need to see how your content is stored first.
What does it cost to run?

Search usually costs little per query. Some tools bill by the month and some by use, always through your own account. We estimate the monthly cost for your traffic and explain it in the handover notes.
Does it show products that are out of stock?
You choose. By default we show them lower in the results with a clear label, or hide them. We set this up using your stock data and explain how to change the rule.
